title: Duan language (Austroasiatic) - Wikipedia
text: Duan, Doan, or Halang Doan, is a language spoken by more than 4,000 people on either side of the Laotian – Vietnamese border. There are some 2,346 speakers in Attopu Province, Laos, and another couple of thousand in Kon Tum Province, Vietnam.

title: Duan language (Austroasiatic) — Grokipedia
text: The Duan language, also known as Halang Doan (ISO 639-3: hld), is a threatened Austroasiatic language of the Bahnaric branch, spoken by approximately 5,000 people (as of 2020) primarily along the border between Vietnam and Laos.
